storage.title: Storage settings
storage.description: Configure shared storage or your own S3. Credentials are encrypted on the server and never displayed.
storage.recoveryPending: Storage recovery is incomplete for this space. Access to its artifacts is paused and existing files are preserved. Ask the administrator to check the storage connection and pending recovery records.
storage.s3Help: This space is bound to S3. Files are accessed through the server cache, and existing files are preserved.
storage.localHelp: Saving settings or testing a connection does not move files. Existing artifacts are still read from the server disk.
storage.pathStyle: Use path-style addressing (compatible with most self-hosted S3 services)
storage.endpointHelp: Use a public HTTPS service root. Configure the Bucket and prefix separately. Private addresses and self-signed certificates are not supported.
storage.credentialsHelp: Use dedicated credentials restricted to this Bucket.
storage.credentialsSaved: Credentials are encrypted. Leave all fields empty to retain them. To replace them, enter both Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
storage.credentialsRequired: Enter both Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
storage.saved: Configuration saved. Storage has not changed. Test the connection next.
storage.testing: Writing, verifying and cleaning up a test object…
storage.cleanup: Could not clean up the test object. Delete this object from the Bucket before retrying:
storage.notMigrated: Read, write and delete access verified. Files have not migrated and storage is unchanged.
storage.limitHelp: This is the budget allocated by this instance, not the S3 provider’s actual available capacity. Zero allocates no shared capacity.
